subject: Medibridge one-time accelerator rate clearance request
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medibridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medibridge.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time accelerator rate for Q4 pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and cost profile. We have an internal constraint: the budget for the Q4 pilot is fixed and we need a short-term unit price below your published starter tier to fit procurement approvals.

Specifically, can Redwood provide a one-time adjusted token rate for the 3-month pilot (Oct–Dec) tied to a committed usage floor of 150M tokens? If possible, we’d like that reflected in SOW v2 so our procurement team can sign off.

Attached: Medibridge_SOW_v2.pdf, usage extract for current POC.

Appreciate a quick yes/no — our procurement deadline is Friday.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Head of Procurement
Medibridge

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-time accelerator rate for Q4 pilot — exec clearance request

Hi Logan / Grace,

Forwarding a Medibridge ask — they want a one-time, timebound unit rate below starter tier in exchange for a 3-month committed floor (150M tokens). Prospect quality: product org showed real ROI indicators (semantic search + summarization), and they move fast on procurement.

Why I’m escalating: the requested price is outside our standard guardrails and would require VP/CFO sign-off for a deviation >20% from list. We have a signed PO intent but need the commercial change in the SOW before legal/procurement will sign.

Quick facts:
- Account: Medibridge (healthcare SaaS)
- Proposed term: 3 months (Oct–Dec 2027)
- Commit: 150M tokens guaranteed, monthly floor 50M tokens
- Current starter list: $0.005/token (hypothetical)
- Customer asks: $0.0035/token for the pilot (30% off starter)
- Upside: likely enterprise rollout in H1 2028 if pilot meets latency/cost targets

Attachments included from customer. Please see the attached SOW for contract references.

Asks:
1) Can we approve a one-time 30% ad-hoc pilot rate against commit (exec sign-off)?
2) If approved, do we require a clause for automatic reversion to starter list at pilot end and an early-exit clawback?

I recommend approval conditional on: signed commit, DPA in place, and automatic reversion to list pricing with a pro-rated clawback if usage falls under the floor.

If you want I can draft the memo language for VP/CFO sign-off (short bullet justification + financial delta). They need an answer by Friday COB.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Finance Approvals <finance-approvals@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: one-time accelerator rate for Q4 pilot — exec clearance request

Team,

Summarizing the ask and financial impact for quick review:
- Deal: Medibridge (DEAL-9876)
- Proposed one-time pilot rate: $0.0035/token for Oct–Dec (150M token floor)
- Expected revenue over pilot: $525k (150M * $0.0035)
- Revenue at list: $750k (150M * $0.005)
- Gross delta: -$225k over 3 months (30% concession)
- NPV impact: negligible given small ACV and strong reference potential; potential ARR upside >$1.2M if enterprise rollout occurs in H1 2028
- Risk mitigations proposed by Naomi: guaranteed commit, clawback if floor unmet, auto-revert to list pricing after pilot, DPA signed

Requesting VP/CFO exception: authorization to offer the one-time pilot rate for Q4. Please indicate approval and any conditions (reporting cadence, usage checkpoints, post-pilot pricing transition).

If approved, I will instruct Legal to add a 45-day clawback clause and Sales Ops to create a short-run discount code linked to DEAL-9876.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Finance Approvals <finance-approvals@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Fwd: Request: one-time accelerator rate for Q4 pilot — exec clearance request

Logan / Naomi,

Finance is provisionally OK with a one-time concession given the commit and upside. Conditions:
- Require signed commit and PO before discount takes effect.
- Add a clawback tied to usage shortfall (pro-rated refund).
- Monthly usage checkpoints (Oct/Nov/Dec) with Sales Ops reporting to Finance.
- Cap total concession exposure at $250k (does not include potential over-usage revenue).

We’ll escalate to CFO for final signature. Please attach the short memo describing strategic rationale + projected lift if pilot expands.

—Finance Approvals (on behalf of CFO)
